verses.restored: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

familiar.text: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

modern.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל תַּשְׁחֵת֮ לְדָוִ֪ד מִ֫כְתָּ֥ם בִּשְׁלֹ֥חַ שָׁא֑וּל וַֽיִּשְׁמְר֥וּ אֶת הַ֝בַּ֗יִת לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ הַצִּילֵ֖נִי מֵאֹיְבַ֥י אֱלֹהָ֑י מִּמִתְקוֹמְמַ֥י תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

familiar.text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

modern.text: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.

original.text: הַ֭צִּילֵנִי מִפֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וּֽמֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי

verses.restored: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O YHWH.

familiar.text: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.

modern.text: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.

original.text: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אָֽרְב֡וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וּרוּ עָלַ֣י עַזִ֑ים לֹא פִשְׁעִ֖י וְלֹא חַטָּאתִ֣י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

familiar.text: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

modern.text: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.

original.text: בְּֽלִי עָ֭וֺן יְרוּצ֣וּן וְיִכּוֹנָ֑נוּ ע֖וּרָה לִקְרָאתִ֣י וּרְאֵה

verses.restored: Thou therefore, O YHWH God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the nations: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

familiar.text: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

modern.text: O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah

original.text: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָֽה אֱלֹהִ֥ים צְבָא֡וֹת אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָקִ֗יצָה לִפְקֹ֥ד כָּֽל הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַל תָּחֹ֨ן כָּל בֹּ֖גְדֵי אָ֣וֶן סֶֽלָה

verses.restored: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

familiar.text: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

modern.text: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.

original.text: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר

verses.restored: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

familiar.text: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

modern.text: See what they spew from their mouths— sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”

original.text: הִנֵּ֤ה יַבִּ֘יע֤וּן בְּפִיהֶ֗ם חֲ֭רָבוֹת בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי מִ֥י שֹׁמֵֽעַ

verses.restored: But thou, O YHWH, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the nations in derision.

familiar.text: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

modern.text: But You, O LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.

original.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׂחַק לָ֑מוֹ תִּ֝לְעַ֗ג לְכָל גּוֹיִֽם

verses.restored: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

familiar.text: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

modern.text: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.

original.text: עֻ֭זּוֹ אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑רָה כִּֽי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי

verses.restored: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

familiar.text: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

modern.text: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.

original.text: אֱלֹהֵ֣י חסדו יְקַדְּמֵ֑נִי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יַרְאֵ֥נִי בְשֹׁרְרָֽי

verses.restored: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

familiar.text: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

modern.text: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.

original.text: אַל תַּהַרְגֵ֤ם פֶּֽן יִשְׁכְּח֬וּ עַמִּ֗י הֲנִיעֵ֣מוֹ בְ֭חֵילְךָ וְהוֹרִידֵ֑מוֹ מָֽגִנֵּ֣נוּ אֲדֹנָֽי

verses.restored: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

familiar.text: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

modern.text: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.

original.text: חַטַּאת פִּ֗ימוֹ דְּֽבַר שְׂפָ֫תֵ֥ימוֹ וְיִלָּכְד֥וּ בִגְאוֹנָ֑ם וּמֵאָלָ֖ה וּמִכַּ֣חַשׁ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ

verses.restored: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob to the ends of the earth. Selah.

familiar.text: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

modern.text: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah

original.text: כַּלֵּ֥ה בְחֵמָה֮ כַּלֵּ֪ה וְֽאֵ֫ינֵ֥מוֹ וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי אֱ֭לֹהִים מֹשֵׁ֣ל בְּיַעֲקֹ֑ב לְאַפְסֵ֖י הָאָ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה

verses.restored: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

familiar.text: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

modern.text: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.

original.text: וְיָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַכָּ֗לֶב וִיס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר

verses.restored: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

familiar.text: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

modern.text: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.

original.text: הֵ֭מָּה ינועון לֶאֱכֹ֑ל אִם לֹ֥א יִ֝שְׂבְּע֗וּ וַיָּלִֽינוּ

verses.restored: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

familiar.text: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

modern.text: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֤י אָשִׁ֣יר עֻזֶּךָ֮ וַאֲרַנֵּ֥ן לַבֹּ֗קֶר חַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ כִּֽי הָיִ֣יתָ מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לִ֑י וּ֝מָנ֗וֹס בְּי֣וֹם צַר לִֽי

verses.restored: To thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

familiar.text: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

modern.text: To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.

original.text: עֻ֭זִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֲזַמֵּ֑רָה כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י אֱלֹהֵ֥י חַסְדִּֽי
